storyEffectRecipe.alignmentRule: The ferry landing, bridge, recorder, and vermilion thread repeat with changed meaning; nostalgia may preserve memory but cannot demand that others return to an older life.

imageGeneration.outputMode: scenes 1-2 retain portrait paper compositions; scenes 3-5 open into landscape reality while preserving protagonist, location and vermilion thread
imageGeneration.commonPromptRecipe: contemporary Chinese ink wash on rice paper, more than half intentional negative space, pale celadon/charcoal/muted indigo with one faded-vermilion accent, no text, calligraphy, logo, extra person, photorealism or supernatural event

tts.credentialBoundary: API key is read from a private environment file at process runtime and is not stored in this repository.

soundDesign.ambient: deterministic low-level filtered pink noise and 92Hz tone
soundDesign.purpose: create a restrained riverbank bed under speech without representing field-recorded factual audio
